``` {r}
# Identifying sectors for non-refundable deposits 

# Sorting Resort Hotel bookings 

resort_hb_q3 <- hotel_booking %>%
  filter(hotel == "Resort Hotel") %>%
  mutate(
  lead_time_groups = case_when(
    lead_time <= 14 ~ "Last Minute",
    lead_time <= 90 ~ "Short Term",
    lead_time <= 200 ~ "Medium Term",
    TRUE ~ "Advance Term"
  ),
  booking_channel = case_when(
    market_segment == "Online TA" | market_segment == "Offline TA" ~ "External",
    market_segment == "Direct" ~ "Direct",
    market_segment == "Corporate" ~ "Corporate",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
  )

resort_risk_table <- resort_hb_q3 %>%
  group_by(booking_channel, lead_time_groups) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bookings = n(),
    total_canceled = sum(is_canceled),
    cancellation_rate = (total_canceled / total_bookings) * 100,
    mean_adr = mean(adr)
    
  ) %>%
  ungroup() 

resort_risk_table_sorted <- resort_risk_table %>%
  arrange(desc(cancellation_rate))

```

``` {r}
# Visualizing for resort hotel 

resort_risk_table$lead_time_groups <- factor(
  resort_risk_table$lead_time_groups,
                            levels = c("Last Minute", "Short Term", "Medium Term", "Advance Term"))


library(ggplot2)
ggplot(resort_risk_table, aes( x = lead_time_groups, y = booking_channel, fill = cancellation_rate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title = "Risk Analysis for Resort Hotel",
    y = "Distribution Channels",
    x = "Booking Time"
  ) +
  theme_gray() 


```

```{r}
# Modelling for Resort Hotel 

library(tidyverse)

library(tidymodels)

resort_model <- resort_hb_q3 %>%
  mutate(
    is_canceled = factor(is_canceled, levels = c("1", "0")),
    booking_channel = as.factor(booking_channel)
  ) %>%
  select(is_canceled, lead_time_groups, booking_channel) %>%
  drop_na()

set.seed(123)
resort_split <- initial_split(resort_model, prop = 0.80)
resort_train <- training(resort_split)
resort_test <- testing(resort_split)

resort_recipe <- recipe(is_canceled ~ lead_time_groups + booking_channel, data = resort_train) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

resort_mod <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm")

resort_wflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(resort_recipe) %>%
  add_model(resort_mod)

resort_fit <- resort_wflow %>%
  fit(data = resort_train)

tidy(resort_fit)

resort_preds <- predict(resort_fit, resort_test, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(resort_test)


resort_preds %>%
  select(is_canceled, lead_time_groups, booking_channel, .pred_1) %>%
  head(10)

resort_preds %>%
  roc_auc(truth = is_canceled, .pred_1)

resort_preds %>%
  roc_curve(truth = is_canceled, .pred_1) %>%
  autoplot()

```

```{r}
#Percentage of cancellations by distribution channel for resort hotel

cancellations_by_channel_resort <- hotel_booking_resort %>%
  group_by(distribution_channel) %>%
  summarise(
    total_number_bookings_resort = n(),
    total_cancelled_resort = sum(is_canceled == 1),
    percentage_cancelled_resort = mean(is_canceled) * 100
  )
print(cancellations_by_channel_resort)
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
#Graph for cancelled bookings for each distribution channel for resort hotel


cancellations_by_channel_resort %>%
  filter(distribution_channel != "Undefined") %>%
ggplot(aes(x = reorder(distribution_channel, -percentage_cancelled_resort),
           y = percentage_cancelled_resort,
       fill = distribution_channel)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage_cancelled_resort, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Distribution Channel",
    y = "percentage cancelled (%)",
    title = "Percentage of bookings cancelled across each distribution channel for Resort Hotel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal ()
```
